title: What least squares minimizes
summary: Residuals, squared error, and a second feature that is still linear.

choices.text: Adding the second feature makes the model nonlinear in the weights, so the fit needs gradient descent instead of a closed form.
It minimizes the squared error on held-out rows, which is why its training error can be higher than a model fit to the training set.
It minimizes the sum of absolute residuals, which is what makes the fit robust to a few large outliers.
It minimizes the sum of squared residuals on the training rows. A residual is y minus the model's prediction.
